summary: Study Cards is a local flash-card app where a user adds cards with a question and an answer, edits them, searches cards by question, and deletes a card after confirming. Cards are stored on the device and restored after restart.
targetUsers: Students and self-learners who memorize question-and-answer pairs
Anyone who wants a simple on-device flash-card collection
goals: Keep a personal collection of question-and-answer flash cards on the device
Let the user add, edit, search, and delete cards
Restore the saved card collection after restart
nonGoals: Sharing or syncing cards across devices

features.name: Card list
features.userOutcome: See all saved flash cards and pick one to inspect
features.trigger: The app opens, or the user returns to the card list
features.behavior: Shows every saved card as a row with its question and answer, ordered newest created first. Selecting a row shows that card read-only with an Edit button. When no cards exist the list shows 'No cards yet'. The list loads saved cards from the device when the app starts; if that load fails, the list shows 'Cards could not be loaded' and stays empty.
features.failureOutcome: Saved cards cannot be read at startup, so the list shows 'Cards could not be loaded' and stays empty
acceptanceSignals: With two saved cards, the list shows both rows ordered newest created first
Selecting a row shows that card's question and answer read-only with an Edit button
With no saved cards, the list shows 'No cards yet'
When the store read fails, the list shows 'Cards could not be loaded' and contains no rows

features.name: Add card
features.userOutcome: Save a new flash card with a question and an answer
features.trigger: The user chooses to add a card
features.behavior: Opens a form with a required question field and a required answer field. The form checks that both fields are non-empty before saving; saving stores the card with its creation time and returns to the card list, where the new card appears first.
features.failureOutcome: The card cannot be written to the device, so the form stays open with the entered question and answer and shows 'Card could not be saved'
acceptanceSignals: Submitting a question and answer stores a card that reads back from the store with those exact values
Submitting with an empty question or empty answer does not store a card
After a successful save the new card appears first in the card list
When the store write fails, no card is added and the form keeps the entered values

features.name: Edit card
features.userOutcome: Change the question or answer of an existing card
features.trigger: The user presses Edit on a selected card
features.behavior: Opens a form pre-filled with the card's question and answer. The form checks that both fields are non-empty before saving; saving updates the stored card and returns to the card list, where the card shows its new values.
features.failureOutcome: The change cannot be written to the device, so the form stays open with the edited values and shows 'Card could not be saved'
acceptanceSignals: The edit form opens pre-filled with the selected card's question and answer
Saving changed values updates the stored card so it reads back with the new question and answer
Submitting an empty question or empty answer does not change the stored card
When the store write fails, the stored card keeps its previous values

features.name: Search cards by question
features.userOutcome: Narrow the card list to cards whose question matches typed text
features.trigger: The user types in the search field above the card list
features.behavior: Filters the card list to cards whose question contains the typed text, ignoring letter case. The search field starts empty, which shows all cards. Clearing the search field returns to showing all cards. When no card matches, the list shows 'No matching cards'.
features.failureOutcome: The typed text cannot be applied, so the list keeps showing the previous results
acceptanceSignals: With an empty search field the list shows all saved cards
Typing text shows only cards whose question contains that text, ignoring letter case
Typing text that matches no question shows 'No matching cards'
Clearing the search field shows all saved cards again

features.name: Delete card
features.userOutcome: Remove a card from the collection after confirming
features.trigger: The user chooses to delete the selected card
features.behavior: Asks for confirmation before removing the card. Confirming removes the card from the device and returns to the card list without it; cancelling keeps the card unchanged.
features.failureOutcome: The card cannot be removed from the device, so the card stays in the list and 'Card could not be deleted' is shown
acceptanceSignals: Choosing delete shows a confirmation prompt and the card remains stored until it is confirmed
Confirming removes the card so it no longer reads back from the store and no longer appears in the list
Cancelling the confirmation leaves the card stored and listed
When the store delete fails, the card remains stored and listed

dataObjects.name: Flash cards
dataObjects.purpose: The user's saved question-and-answer flash cards
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device until the user deletes a card

qualityRequirements: Card list, add, edit, search, and delete work fully offline on the device
productConstraints: Cards are stored only on the device and are not synced or shared
